meta_title: Fonder — a film camera for iPhone
meta_description: Fonder is a film camera for iPhone: {{film_count}} films, recipes you set like a camera, and Film Roll — shoot a roll, then develop it.
lang_bar_text: Xem trang này bằng tiếng Việt?
consent_text: This site uses Google Analytics to count visits. OK?
ch0_title: The feeling of film, not just the look.
ch0_line: A film camera for iPhone that brings back limited frames, anticipation, and the joy of seeing a roll for the first time.
why_title: Phone cameras became nearly perfect. Somewhere along the way, taking photos became less exciting.
why_cycle: Shoot. Check. Delete. Reshoot. Edit. Post.
why_line: Fonder slows that down. Pick a film, trust the frame, and keep living.
ch1_title: Pick a film. Then forget about it.
ch1_lead: Load the look you want before the moment happens. Set it once. Then shoot.
ch1_body: Still mode opens on a recipe, with the white balance and exposure in the corners of the frame. Pick a recipe on any of {{film_count}} films, then set it like a camera: white balance, dynamic range, grain, colour. Still and Roll.
ch2_title: See it when the roll is done.
ch2_lead: Half the fun is not knowing.
ch2_body: Films fitted to real camera renders, not filters painted by eye. Halation, grain and the whole look are rendered on the iPhone, in the viewfinder and in the photo.
app_note_developing: Each frame gets the look you loaded. No settings to choose.
app_note_developed: Final photos. The Toffee Neg look is set, so there’s nothing to edit or regrade.
roll_body: Load 12, 24 or 36 exposures. Take the picture and move on. No deleting the bad ones. No taking twelve versions of the good ones. Finish your roll. Then see what you got.
ch3_lead: Nothing important happened. That’s why you’ll be glad you photographed it.
ch3_body: Load a roll, shoot it blind, then develop it all at once — with a border and a date stamp if you like.
ch3_contact_caption: A developed roll, straight from Film Roll.
action_follow_title: There are photos you haven’t taken yet.
action_follow_body: Fonder is coming to iPhone. Join the first group to load a roll.
footer_line: Made in Hà Nội by Trung Hai.

rteaser_body: A film character plus the darkroom decisions around it. Every recipe Fonder ships, taken apart on one frame — and one scene developed through them all.
dteaser_body: Notes from making the films, breaking things, fixing them, and trying to make an iPhone feel a little more like a camera again.
